bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6 --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 62
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 63
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 64

ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test -f "$ROOT/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" || exit 66
python3 -B "$ROOT/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 67
python3 -B "$ROOT/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" bot_start_menu >/dev/null || exit 68
python3 -B "$ROOT/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 69
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
